## KL divergence code 

```{r cars}

# KL divergence for two probability vectors
kl_divergence <- function(p, q, epsilon = 1e-12) {
  p <- as.numeric(p)
  q <- as.numeric(q)
  
  # add epsilon for numerical stability
  p <- p + epsilon
  q <- q + epsilon
  
  # renormalize
  p <- p / sum(p)
  q <- q / sum(q)
  
  sum(p * log(p / q))
}

# main function
get_kl_by_item <- function(human_df, model_df, epsilon = 1e-12) {
  
  prob_cols <- c("image1", "image2", "image3", "image4")
  
  # keep only needed columns from model df
  model_small <- model_df %>%
    select(item_uid, all_of(prob_cols))
  
  # join model distribution onto every human row by item_uid
  joined_df <- human_df %>%
    left_join(
      model_small,
      by = "item_uid",
      suffix = c("_human", "_model")
    )
  
  # compute KL(human || model) for each human row
  kl_df <- joined_df %>%
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(
      kl_divergence = kl_divergence(
        p = c_across(all_of(paste0(prob_cols, "_human"))),
        q = c_across(all_of(paste0(prob_cols, "_model"))),
        epsilon = epsilon
      )
    ) %>%
    ungroup()
  
  return(kl_df)
}
```

# sample n runs from full data
```{r pressure, echo=FALSE}

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)

# KL helper: KL(P || Q)
compute_kl <- function(p, q, eps = 1e-12) {
  p <- p + eps
  q <- q + eps
  sum(p * log(p / q))
}

make_item_distribution_no_save <- function(processed_df) {
  possible_images <- c("image1", "image2", "image3", "image4")
  
  distribution_df <- processed_df %>%
    filter(!is.na(matched_image)) %>%
    count(item_uid, matched_image) %>%
    pivot_wider(
      names_from = matched_image,
      values_from = n,
      values_fill = 0
    )
  
  for (img in possible_images) {
    if (!img %in% names(distribution_df)) {
      distribution_df[[img]] <- 0
    }
  }
  
  distribution_df %>%
    mutate(across(all_of(possible_images), ~ coalesce(.x, 0))) %>%
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(total = sum(c_across(all_of(possible_images)))) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(across(all_of(possible_images), ~ ifelse(total > 0, .x / total, 0))) %>%
    select(item_uid, all_of(possible_images))
}

estimate_subsample_kl <- function(
  simulated_df,
  ground_truth_distribution_df,
  N = 10,
  n_samples = 100,
  eps = 1e-12,
  seed = NULL
) {
  if (!is.null(seed)) set.seed(seed)
  
  possible_images <- c("image1", "image2", "image3", "image4")
  
  run_ids <- unique(simulated_df$run_id)
  
  if (N > length(run_ids)) {
    stop("N cannot be larger than the number of unique run_ids.")
  }
  
  kl_results <- map_dfr(seq_len(n_samples), function(i) {
    
    sampled_run_ids <- sample(run_ids, size = N, replace = FALSE)
    
    sampled_df <- simulated_df %>%
      filter(run_id %in% sampled_run_ids)
    
    sampled_distribution_df <- make_item_distribution_no_save(sampled_df)
    
    joined_df <- ground_truth_distribution_df %>%
      select(item_uid, all_of(possible_images)) %>%
      rename_with(~ paste0(.x, "_true"), all_of(possible_images)) %>%
      left_join(
        sampled_distribution_df %>%
          select(item_uid, all_of(possible_images)) %>%
          rename_with(~ paste0(.x, "_sample"), all_of(possible_images)),
        by = "item_uid"
      ) %>%
      mutate(
        across(ends_with("_sample"), ~ coalesce(.x, 0))
      )
    
    item_kl_df <- joined_df %>%
      rowwise() %>%
      mutate(
        kl_divergence = compute_kl(
          c_across(ends_with("_true")),
          c_across(ends_with("_sample")),
          eps = eps
        )
      ) %>%
      ungroup()
    
    tibble(
      sample_id = i,
      N = N,
      sampled_run_ids = paste(sampled_run_ids, collapse = ","),
      mean_kl = mean(item_kl_df$kl_divergence, na.rm = TRUE),
      median_kl = median(item_kl_df$kl_divergence, na.rm = TRUE)
    )
  })
  
  list(
    average_kl = mean(kl_results$mean_kl, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_kl = sd(kl_results$mean_kl, na.rm = TRUE),
    kl_results = kl_results
  )
}

```

Note that the `echo = FALSE` parameter was added to the code chunk to prevent printing of the R code that generated the plot.


```{r}
result <- estimate_subsample_kl(
  simulated_df = egma_math_processed,
  ground_truth_distribution_df = egma_math_distribution,
  N = 10,
  n_samples = 100,
  seed = 123
)

result$average_kl
result$kl_results
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(purrr)

library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(ggplot2)

plot_kl_vs_N <- function(
  simulated_df,
  ground_truth_distribution_df,
  N_values = c(10, 20, 40),
  n_samples = 100,
  seed = 123
) {
  
  if (!is.null(seed)) set.seed(seed)
  
  results_list <- purrr::map(N_values, function(N) {
    
    res <- estimate_subsample_kl(
      simulated_df = simulated_df,
      ground_truth_distribution_df = ground_truth_distribution_df,
      N = N,
      n_samples = n_samples
    )
    
    res$kl_results %>%
      dplyr::mutate(N = N)
  })
  
  combined_results <- dplyr::bind_rows(results_list) %>%
    dplyr::rename(kl_value = mean_kl)
  
  summary_df <- combined_results %>%
    dplyr::group_by(N) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      mean_kl = mean(kl_value, na.rm = TRUE),
      sd_kl = sd(kl_value, na.rm = TRUE),
      n = sum(!is.na(kl_value)),
      se_kl = sd_kl / sqrt(n),
      ci_kl = 1.96 * se_kl,
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  
  p <- ggplot(summary_df, aes(x = factor(N), y = mean_kl)) +
    geom_col(width = 0.6, fill = "steelblue") +
    geom_errorbar(
      aes(
        ymin = mean_kl - se_kl,
        ymax = mean_kl + se_kl
      ),
      width = 0.2,
      linewidth = 0.8
    ) +
    labs(
      x = "Number of sampled runs (N)",
      y = "Average KL divergence",
      title = "KL divergence vs. subsample size"
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 14)
  
  return(list(
    plot = p,
    summary_df = summary_df,
    raw_results = combined_results
  ))
}


```



```{r}
out <- plot_kl_vs_N(
  simulated_df = vocab_processed,
  ground_truth_distribution_df = vocab_distribution,
  N_values = c(10, 20, 40),
  n_samples = 100
)

out$plot
out$summary_df
```
